Greenville probate has a free public name/case-number index (appsAS400/Probate); only documents need a request or subscription.
southcarolinaprobate.net returned 403 to plain requests on 2026-10-07; Charleston's main GIS parcel service (New_Parcel_Search) was stopped (error 500), the energov_css layer works.
Seven counties (Bamberg, Cherokee, Chester, Chesterfield, Dillon, Edgefield, Fairfield) use the Avenu/Neumo GRIDS portal; Cherokee's terms forbid automation, the rest are treated the same.
summary.how_counted: rod_open_free: free name search reachable by plain request with no login (open or one-click disclaimer) and no terms against automation. rod_walled: login, CAPTCHA, payment, bot block (Cloudflare/Akamai) or terms that forbid automation; several of these are still free for a person in a browser (see each county's notes). rod_unreachable: no online ROD index found. rod_not_determined: an Avenu/Neumo GRIDS portal whose search and terms could not be read without running its JS app (same vendor as Cherokee, whose terms forbid automation). images_free counts counties where free deed images were confirmed (by us or the county's own page), including ones only a person can reach. legal_description_online: a free route to a legal description exists - free deed image, legal text in the ROD index, or a legal-description field in free county GIS (GIS legal is the assessor's short form, not the deed text). index_back_to_before_1980: earliest year a free online index (typed or scanned index books) reaches is before 1980.
